func _init(p_questions: Array[Question] = []) -> void:
	questions = p_questions
	current_index = 0
	score = 0


func get_current_question() -> Question:
	if current_index >= questions.size():
		return null
	return questions[current_index]


func answer(index: int) -> bool:
	var q := get_current_question()
	if q == null:
		return false
	var correct := q.is_correct(index)
	if correct:
		score += 1
	current_index += 1
	return correct


func is_finished() -> bool:
	return current_index >= questions.size()
